Sets where the response is inserted. Takes a CSS selector, `this`, or an extended selector: `closest <selector>`, `find <selector>`, `next [selector]`, `previous [selector]`. Defaults to the element itself.

**Inheritance**

Use the `:inherited` modifier (for example, `ypy-target:inherited`) to apply this attribute to YPY requests in child elements.

Chooses how the response is inserted into the target. Styles: `innerHTML`, `outerHTML`, `textContent`, `beforebegin`, `afterbegin`, `beforeend`, `afterend`, `innerMorph`, `outerMorph`, `outerSync`, `delete`, `none`, and the styles that extensions add (`download`, `upsert`). Modifiers follow the style.

Syntax: `<style> [<modifier>...]`

**Values**

- `innerHTML`: Replaces the inner HTML of the target.
- `outerHTML`: Replaces the target element.
- `outerSync`: Morphs the attributes of the target, then replaces its children. The target stays in the DOM.
- `innerMorph`: Morphs the children of the target, keeping DOM state such as focus and open details. The default.
- `outerMorph`: Morphs the target itself, keeping DOM state.
- `textContent`: Replaces the text of the target. The response is not parsed as HTML.
- `beforebegin`: Inserts before the target. `before` is a synonym.
- `afterbegin`: Inserts before the first child of the target. `prepend` is a synonym.
- `beforeend`: Inserts after the last child of the target. `append` is a synonym.
- `afterend`: Inserts after the target. `after` is a synonym.
- `delete`: Deletes the target whatever the response holds.
- `none`: Does not swap. Out-of-band swaps and headers still run.

**Modifiers**

- `swap:<time>`: Delay before the swap.
- `settle:<time>`: Delay between the swap and the settle.
- `transition:true`: Uses the View Transitions API for this swap.
- `ignoreTitle:true`: Does not update the document title from the response.
- `scroll:top|bottom`: Scrolls the target after the swap.
- `show:top|bottom`: Scrolls the target into the viewport.
- `scrollTarget:<selector>`: Scrolls this element instead of the target.
- `showTarget:<selector>`: Scrolls this element into view instead of the target.
- `strip:true`: Removes the outer wrapper element before swapping.
- `focusScroll:true`: Scrolls to the focused element.
- `swapEmpty:true`: Runs the main swap even when nothing remains after the out-of-band and partial content is removed.
- `target:<selector>`: Retargets the swap.

**Inheritance**

Chooses which events start the request of the element. Takes a comma separated list of event specifications, each with optional filters and modifiers. Without it, inputs and selects trigger on `change`, forms on `submit` and everything else on `click`.

Syntax: `<event>[<filter>] [<modifier>...][, ...]`

**Values**

- `load`: Fires when the element is loaded.
- `revealed`: Fires when the element scrolls into the viewport.
- `intersect`: Fires when the element intersects the viewport. Takes `root:<selector>` and `threshold:<number>`.
- `every <time>`: Polls at an interval, for example `every 2s`.

**Modifiers**

- `once`: Fires only once.
- `changed`: Fires only when the value of the element changed.
- `delay:<time>`: Debounces: a new event resets the countdown.
- `throttle:<time>`: The first event fires at once, later events wait for the cooldown.
- `from:<selector>`: Listens on another element. Accepts `document`, `window`, `body`, `closest`, `find`, `next`, `previous`, `self` and `outside`.
- `target:<selector>`: Fires only when `event.target` matches the selector.
- `prevent`: Calls `event.preventDefault()`.
- `stop`: Calls `event.stopPropagation()`. `consume` is a synonym.
- `halt`: Shorthand for `prevent stop`.
- `capture`: Listens in the capture phase.
- `passive`: Tells the browser the listener will not call `preventDefault()`.
- `root:<selector>`: With `intersect`: the observer root.
- `threshold:<number>`: With `intersect`: the visible fraction that fires, from 0 to 1.

**Inheritance**

Use the `:inherited` modifier (for example, `ypy-trigger:inherited`) to apply this attribute to YPY requests in child elements.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:before:process` fires. Fires before YPY processes a DOM node or subtree. Cancel it to leave the subtree unprocessed.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:after:process` fires. Fires after YPY processed a DOM node or subtree.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:before:init` fires. Fires before YPY attaches its internal data to an element. Cancel it to leave the element alone.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:after:init` fires. Fires after an element has all its YPY behaviors and listeners.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:before:on:init` fires. Fires before YPY binds the `ypy-on` attributes of an element. Cancel it to leave them unbound.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:before:cleanup` fires. Fires before YPY removes listeners and internal data from an element, on removal during a swap or before reprocessing.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:after:cleanup` fires. Fires after YPY removed the listeners and internal data of an element.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:confirm` fires. Fires when an element with `ypy-confirm` is triggered, before the request. Call `preventDefault()` to replace the dialog, then call `issueRequest()` or `dropRequest()`; the request waits until one is called.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:config:request` fires. Fires after the request values are collected and validated, before encoding and sending. Change `ctx.request` to adjust headers, timeout or credentials. Cancel it to stop the request.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:before:request` fires. Fires right before `fetch()`, after all configuration. Cancel it to stop the request.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:before:response` fires. Fires once the response headers arrive, before the body is read. `ctx.response.raw` is the unconsumed `Response`. Cancel it to skip the body and the swap.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:after:request` fires. Fires after the response body was read, before the swap. `ctx.response` holds the status and headers. Cancel it to skip the swap.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:response:error` fires. Fires when the server answers with status 400 or more. It does not fire for network errors; use `ypy:error` for those.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:error` fires. Fires when an exception ends the request or the swap. It does not fire for HTTP 4xx or 5xx. `ctx` is absent when the error happens before the request context exists.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:finally:request` fires. Fires when a request completes, fails or is cancelled. It does not fire when processing stops before the request starts.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:before:swap` fires. Fires after the response is parsed and before it is inserted. `tasks` lists the swap tasks. Cancel it to prevent the swap.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:after:swap` fires. Fires after new content is in the DOM, before its elements are processed.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:finally:swap` fires. Fires at the end of the swap lifecycle, whether it succeeded or failed.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:before:settle` fires. Fires after new content is inserted and before CSS transitions are applied. Change `newContent` here.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:after:settle` fires. Fires after the settle phase, including every CSS transition. The DOM is stable.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:before:viewTransition` fires. Fires before a View Transition starts, when `config.transitions` is on and the browser supports it. Cancel it to skip the transition for this swap.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:after:viewTransition` fires. Fires after a View Transition finished.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:before:history:update` fires. Fires before `history.pushState()` or `history.replaceState()`. Cancel it to prevent the history update.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:after:history:update` fires. Fires after `history.pushState()` or `history.replaceState()` completed.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:after:history:push` fires. Fires after a new history entry was created.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:after:history:replace` fires. Fires after the current history entry was replaced.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:before:history:restore` fires. Fires when the user navigates back or forward, before the page is restored. Cancel it to restore by hand. Extensions such as `ypy-history-cache` can handle a cache hit.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:history:restore:fragment` fires. Fires when a history restore got something that is not a whole page. The page is reloaded right after. Turn the safety net off with `config.historyRestore.fragment`.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:abort` fires. Control event: dispatch it on an element to abort its request in flight. YPY listens to it; it does not fire it.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:request:queued` fires. A request waits behind the one in flight (`queue first`, `queue last`, `queue all`).
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:request:dropped` fires. A request that never ran was discarded; `ctx` is that request.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:request:aborted` fires. The request in flight was aborted before its response; `ctx` is that request.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:offline` fires. The browser went offline: `<html>` carries the offline class. Fires on `document`.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:online` fires. The connection came back, or a response proved it. Fires on `document`.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:announce` fires. Fires on the source element just before a message goes into the live region. A listener may change `message` and `politeness`, or cancel to say nothing.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:target:fallback` fires. The main target selector matched nothing and the chain `[ypy-main]`, `<main>` took over. `selector` is what failed, `used` the fallback selector.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:target:missing` fires. No target was found for a main swap, an out-of-band element or a partial. Cancel it to silence the console warning.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:swap:error` fires. A swap task failed while the others went on. Fires once per failed task, before `ypy:after:swap`.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:security:blocked` fires. Author code (`ypy-on`, a `js:` value or a `[filter]` trigger) was not compiled because of `config.callbacks`, or a redirect or WebSocket URL was refused (`reason` `redirect`, `websocket-origin`).
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:ready` fires. Fires once on `document.body`, after YPY processed the page for the first time. Needs the `ypy-boot` extension.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:cache:hit` fires. A stored copy answers the request. `age` is in ms; `offline` is true when the network failed and the copy was shown for that reason.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:cache:revalidated` fires. The check that follows a shown copy ended. `changed` is true when new content was swapped in; `status` is the status of the check.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:cache:expire` fires. Copies were marked old by a `YPY-Cache-Expire` header or `ypy.cache.expire()`. They are still shown, then revalidated. `expired` is how many.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:cache:evict` fires. Copies were deleted by a `YPY-Cache-Evict` header, the default after a successful non-GET request, `ypy.cache.evict()` or `ypy.cache.clear()`. `removed` is how many.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:before:command` fires. Fires on the element that sent the request before one command of `YPY-Commands` runs. `targets` are the elements the selector matched. Cancel it to skip that command.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:commands:ignored` fires. Fires on the element that sent the request when a command, or the whole list, of `YPY-Commands` was not run: unknown type, an invalid field, an invalid selector, a blocked attribute (an event handler, `style`, `srcdoc`, an attribute of YPY or a `javascript:` URL), a list that is not JSON or is longer than `commands.max`. A console warning says the same.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:security:strip` fires. Fires on an element after `ypy-csp` removed its `ypy-*` and `data-ypy-*` attributes because it carried no valid nonce.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:security:violation` fires. Fires when `ypy-csp` stops an action: code evaluated without a valid nonce (`nonce-mismatch-at-eval`), a `javascript:` or `js:` action URL (`javascript-url`) or a boosted form whose submitter changed `formaction` without a nonce (`unnonced-submitter`).

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:csrf:missing` fires. An unsafe (not GET or HEAD) request to the page's own origin is about to leave without a CSRF token: the `ypy-csrf` meta tag is missing or empty. Cancel it to silence the console warning, which is shown once per URL. The request is still sent.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:dedupe:joined` fires. Fires on the source element when its GET request joined an identical request that was already in flight, so only one request goes to the network. `waiters` counts the requests that wait for it, this one included.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:dev:message` fires. Fired by the development extension for every message it writes to the console (an error with context, a warning for incorrect or legacy use, a reload, a POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE cut by `ypy-sync` as `sync-aborted` or `sync-dropped`, a 401, 403 or 419 as `status-401` and the like with `auth: true`). `code` is a stable name, `text` the sentence; other keys depend on the code (`ctx`, `selector`, `status`, `attribute`, `suggestion`, `guide`).
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:download:start` fires. Fires on the source element when a download begins streaming. `total` is the `Content-Length`, or `null` when the server sent none.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:download:progress` fires. Fires on the source element for every chunk received, for progress bars. `percent` is `null` when the total is unknown.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:download:complete` fires. Fires on the source element after the file was handed to the browser as a download.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:head:before:merge` fires. Fires on `document.body` before the head of a response is merged. Cancel it to skip the merge. The detail is the one of `ypy:before:response`.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:head:before:add` fires. Fires before a new element is appended to `<head>`. Cancel it to leave that element out.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:head:before:remove` fires. Fires before an element is removed from `<head>`. Cancel it to keep that element.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:head:after:merge` fires. Fires after the head was merged, with the elements that were added, kept and removed.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:history:cache:before:save` fires. Fires on `document` before the current page is saved to `sessionStorage`. `head` may be changed. Cancel it to skip saving this page.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:history:cache:after:save` fires. Fires on `document` after a page was saved to the cache.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:history:cache:before:restore` fires. Fires on `document` before cached content is swapped back. A listener may set `ready` to a promise that the extension awaits before the swap.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:history:cache:after:restore` fires. Fires on `document` after cached content was restored and the scroll position was set.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:history:cache:hit` fires. Fires on `document` when back or forward finds the page in the cache. Cancel it to ignore the cache and request the page. `item` may be replaced.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:history:cache:miss` fires. Fires on `document` when back or forward finds no cached page. A listener may set `refreshOnMiss` to reload the page.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:layer:before:open` fires. Fires on the opener (or on the document for a call of `ypy.layers.open()`) before a layer is built. Cancel it to open nothing.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:layer:opened` fires. Fires on the dialog once its content is in and it is shown, with the focus inside.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:layer:before:close` fires. Fires on the dialog before it closes, by accept or dismiss. Cancel it to keep the layer open (for example, unsaved changes).
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:layer:accepted` fires. Fires on the dialog, still in the page, when the layer is accepted. `detail.value` is the result value.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:layer:dismissed` fires. Fires on the dialog, still in the page, when the layer is dismissed. `detail.reason` says why: `escape`, `outside`, `parent`, `history`, `toggle`, `navigate`, `error`, `dropped`, `replaced` or the text given to `dismiss()`.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:lazy:error` fires. A region with `ypy-lazy` failed to load (no connection, a status of 400 or more, a swap error). The region has `data-ypy-state="error"`.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:lazy:group` fires. Fires on the first region of a batch just before the group request is sent. `ids` lists the `id` of every region in it.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:list:pruned` fires. Fires on the list after a swap with `limit:<n>` removed its oldest items to keep the limit. `removed` holds them, in document order; they are already out of the page.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:multipart:before:connection` fires. Fires before a multipart connection is used, and again before each reconnect. Cancel it, or set `detail.connection.cancelled = true`, to stop.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:multipart:after:connection` fires. Fires when a multipart response was accepted, on the first connection and after each successful reconnect.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:multipart:before:part` fires. Fires for each part before it is handled. Cancel it, or set `detail.cancelled = true`, to skip the part. `detail.waitUntil(promise)` delays handling.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:multipart:after:part` fires. Fires after a part was swapped or its header actions ran. The part id then counts as received for reconnects.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:multipart:error` fires. Fires when a connection attempt, a reconnect or the parsing of the stream fails. `detail.status` is set when a reconnect got an unusable response.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:multipart:close` fires. Fires once when the connection is cleaned up. `detail.reason` is `cancelled`, `ended`, `removed`, `part` (a `ypy-multipart:close` event fired) or `cleanup`.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:optimistic:applied` fires. The optimistic change was made. Cancel it to undo the change at once.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:optimistic:confirmed` fires. The server accepted the request. The server's content replaces the optimistic one where they meet; elsewhere the optimistic content stays.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:optimistic:rolledback` fires. The page was put back: `reason` is `status`, `error`, `aborted` or `cancelled`.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:track:reload` fires. A page response carries other `ypy-track="reload"` values than the page. Cancel it to swap the response instead of loading `url`.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:poll:stop` fires. Fires on the element when a response with status `286` stopped its polling. The content of that response is swapped as usual.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:prompt` fires. Fires on the element after the user answered. Cancel it to abort the request.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:request:retry` fires. Fires on the source element before a failed request is repeated, after `delay` ms or when the window goes online. `attempt` is 1 for the first repeat. `status` is the status of the answer that is repeated, absent after a network failure. Cancel it to give up; the error is then reported as usual, or the answer is handled as without retry.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:signals:patch` fires. Fires before a merge patch is applied to the signals, whether it came from a JSON response or from `ypy.signals.patch()`. Cancel it to discard the patch.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:signals:readonly` fires. Fires when a write to a read-only signal (server-owned or computed) was refused. `detail.warn` carries the message and is logged as a warning.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:signals:error` fires. Fires when an expression did not parse, a handler or effect threw, or a patch was not usable. The attribute that failed does nothing and the rest of the page keeps working.
Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:sort:change` fires. Fires on the container when an item was put down in a new place, before the order is sent. Cancel it to put the list back.

Runs the JavaScript when `ypy:sort:revert` fires. Fires on the container after the list was put back in its old order: the change was cancelled, the server refused it or did not answer, or the drag was abandoned.

**Modifiers**

- `attempts:<n>`: How many times a failed request is repeated. 3 for a bare attribute, else 0.

- `max:<time>`: Longest wait between two attempts. Default `30s`.
- `backoff:<n>`: Each wait is this many times longer than the one before. Default 2; `1` keeps it constant.
- `jitter:<n>`: Each wait varies at random by up to this fraction (`0.2`) or percentage (`20%`), up and down, so clients do not retry at the same moment. Default `0`; `0` keeps the waits exact.
